title: When and Where to Transfer: Learning Transferable Historical Contexts for Short-History Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.28567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Related sources can improve multivariate time series forecasting when the target history is short, but their usefulness varies across source groups and historical periods. A key challenge is to identify informative historical contexts from the sources. This paper proposes Hierarchical Context Transfer (HiCT), a framework that adaptively weights source groups and their historical contexts to determine both \emph{where} and \emph{when} to transfer. A shared context encoder and cross-attention are used to learn weights over source groups and historical contexts. These weights guide regularized transfer estimation, followed by an optional target-specific correction. This paper establishes a target excess-risk bound for the context-weighted transfer estimator. Experiments demonstrate competitive predictive performance across four multivariate forecasting datasets and a favorable accuracy--runtime trade-off against the evaluated baselines. S

translated_title: 何时与何处迁移：为短历史多变量时间序列预测学习可迁移的历史上下文
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28567v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：当目标历史数据较短时，相关数据源可以改进多变量时间序列预测，但其有用性因数据源群体和历史时期的不同而有所差异。一个关键挑战是从数据源中识别出有信息量的历史上下文。本文提出了分层上下文迁移，这是一个自适应地为数据源群体及其历史上下文分配权重的框架，从而确定在“何处”和“何时”进行迁移。该框架使用共享上下文编码器和交叉注意力机制来学习数据源群体和历史上下文的权重。这些权重引导正则化的迁移估计，随后进行可选的针对目标的校正。本文为上下文加权的迁移估计器建立了目标超额风险界。实验表明，该方法在四个多变量预测数据集上展现出有竞争力的预测性能，并且相对于所评估的基线方法具有更优的精度-运行时间权衡。
tldr: 提出分层上下文迁移框架HiCT，通过共享上下文编码器和交叉注意力自适应地加权数据源群体与历史上下文，确定迁移的时机与来源，以改进短历史多变量时间序列预测，并为其提供了理论上的目标超额风险界。
en_tdlr: Proposes Hierarchical Context Transfer (HiCT), a framework that adaptively weights source groups and their historical contexts via a shared context encoder and cross-attention to determine where and when to transfer, improving short-history multivariate time series forecasting with a theoretical target excess-risk bound.
